findings.highlight: I can hear the apology in her voice for not being able to do more.
findings.evidenceJa: それを許してほしい、と彼女の背中が言っていた。
findings.governingReading: Her back figuratively asks forgiveness for the escape plan’s limits.
findings.explanation: An apology conveyed by her back becomes heard in her voice.

findings.highlight: I don't know about Archer, but Saber can close that distant in a heartbeat.
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーはともかく、セイバーならば一息で詰められる間合いだが—
findings.governingReading: The noun is the distance Saber can close.
He stops walking, then bursts into laughter clutching his stomach.
findings.explanation: His feet stopping becomes his laughter stopping.

findings.highlight: It's...a short sword, shaped like a key.
findings.evidenceJa: 手のひらに収まる程度の、鍵のような短剣が握られていた。
findings.governingReading: He holds a key-like short blade small enough to fit in his palm.
findings.explanation: The palm-sized key-like dagger loses its size.

findings.highlight: If Saber can go back on the offensive with the same fury as before, she should be able to cut through his armor.
findings.evidenceJa: もう一度セイバーが今の猛攻を繰り出せば、鎧ごとヤツを両断するだろう。
findings.governingReading: Shirou predicts the renewed attack will bisect the man along with his armor.
findings.explanation: Cutting both enemy and armor in two becomes cutting armor.

findings.highlight: His swords strike at her in a merciless rain of ice shards.
findings.governingReading: The newly thrust sword is ice; space along its swing freezes, Saber is covered with ice, and the adhering ice shatters as the weapon changes.
findings.explanation: An ice sword freezing its traversed space becomes a rain of flying blades.

findings.highlight: "Answer me, Archer! A Heroic Spirit should only have one Noble Phantasm. Some may have multiple Noble Phantasms, but two is usually the limit.
findings.evidenceJa: 「答えなさいアーチャー……！　英霊が持つ宝具は一つだけの筈。いえ、中には複数の宝具を持っている者もいますが、だとしても二つが限度だ。
findings.governingReading: Saber says even multiple Noble Phantasms are limited to two.
findings.explanation: Two as the limit becomes usually the limit.

findings.highlight: Heroic Spirits make the weapons they used during their life into Noble Phantasms. So it's quite simple. All these Noble Phantasms are things I collected while I was alive."
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊は生前持ち得た武器を宝具とする。ならば単純な話ではないか。この宝具は全て、我が生前に集めたものという事ではないか？」
findings.governingReading: His explanation rests on possessions collected while alive, explicitly including weapons he never used.
findings.explanation: Weapons possessed during life becomes weapons used during life.

findings.highlight: I've finally gotten to the point where I can move, even if it's still difficult.
findings.evidenceJa: 手足。体はようやく、歯を食いしばって指が動く程度にしか回復していない。
findings.governingReading: He has recovered only enough to move his fingers by gritting his teeth.
findings.explanation: Only strained finger movement becomes general difficult movement.

findings.highlight: I push myself to my feet, ignoring the warning.
findings.evidenceJa: 無視して、なんとか上体を起こす。
findings.governingReading: He manages to raise his upper body; he then says he still needs to get up quickly.
findings.explanation: Raising the upper body becomes getting to his feet.

findings.highlight: "I possess the originals of all the Noble Phantasms. But they are all nameless. They are also not the only weapons I possess."
findings.evidenceJa: 「我は全ての宝具の原形を持つ。だがそれらは全て無名であり、我しか持ち得ぬ武具という訳ではない」
findings.governingReading: The nameless prototypes are not exclusively possessable by him, unlike the next sword.
findings.explanation: Not weapons only he can possess becomes not the only weapons he possesses.

findings.governingReading: Light is gathering/converging before the release.
findings.explanation: Converging light becomes light flashing off the weapons.

findings.governingReading: His release comes just before the preceding narrated sacred-sword release.
findings.explanation: Immediately before becomes at the same moment.

findings.highlight: "Ha! So is that all the power humanity's 'strongest' sacred sword can muster!? Human power is truly pathetic!"
findings.evidenceJa: 「く、人類最強の聖剣とやらもその程度か！　人間の幻想など所詮子供だましよな！」
findings.governingReading: He dismisses human fantasies/phantasms as child’s tricks in response to the sacred sword.
